description: This file contains unit tests for the Nix Mode functionality within an application, specifically testing the resolution behavior of the process info with stable and non-stable suites in different contexts (app bundle vs outside app bundle).

methods.name: resolves from stable suite for app bundles
methods.description: Test that the process correctly resolves the Nix mode from a stable suite when running within an app bundle.

methods.name: ignores stable suite outside app bundles
methods.description: Test that the process ignores the stable suite and does not resolve Nix mode when outside an app bundle.
